Go to Divido Valley to find out why there is so less water\nin the river that flows through Flumen Plains!
The water of the river comes from a spring in Divido Valley.\nGo there to check what is happening!
Defeat Vlam the Flame Dragon that is trying to dry\nthe spring up by throwing fireballs from its mouth into it!
